The cleaned Seurat object is converted to a SingleCellExperiment, and Slingshot
is run using `lineage_cluster_name`. The resulting object is saved for tradeSeq
and used to draw the rotated 3D trajectory figure.

```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Load the trajectory and plotting packages and define the user-controlled paths.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  cache = TRUE,
  autodep = TRUE,
  cache.comments = FALSE,
  cache.path = file.path(
    here::here("results", "cache", "publication_pipeline"),
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(knitr::current_input())), "/")
  ),
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5.25,
  dpi = 150
)

options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)

input_path <- file.path(params$download_dir, "cleaned_for_slingshot_60265.rds")

output_root <- here::here()
publication_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))

results_objects_dir <- params$output_dir
plot_dir <- file.path(
  params$output_dir, "plots", "branch_03_slingshot_tradeseq",
  "09_plot_slingshot"
)
projection_dir <- file.path(publication_dir, "assets")

dir.create(results_objects_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(slingshot)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggnewscale)
})

source(file.path(publication_dir, "publication_helpers.R"), local = TRUE)
```

## Read the cleaned Slingshot input

```{r load-input}
# Load the cleaned lineage object produced by notebook 06.
# Use the in-memory cleaned lineage object when available; otherwise load it from disk.
if (exists("lineage_clean")) {
  seu_orig <- lineage_clean
} else {
  seu_orig <- readRDS(input_path)
}
cell_ids <- colnames(seu_orig)
metadata <- seu_orig[[]][cell_ids, , drop = FALSE]

fine_label_column <- "lineage_cluster_name"
fine_labels <- as.character(metadata$lineage_cluster_name)
full_pca <- SeuratObject::Embeddings(seu_orig, "pca")[cell_ids, , drop = FALSE]

cluster_counts <- sort(table(fine_labels), decreasing = TRUE)
cluster_counts
```

## Build the SCE and run Slingshot on PCs 1--5

The `lineage_cluster_name` column is copied into both `cluster_name` and
`clustering` in the SCE. Slingshot receives those fine labels directly through
`clusterLabels`.

```{r run-slingshot}
# Run Slingshot with PCs 1--5, GBC as the start, and HBC, Sus, and MV as endpoints.
counts_mat <- get_assay_matrix(seu_orig, "RNA", "counts")
logcounts_mat <- get_assay_matrix(seu_orig, "RNA", "data")

counts_mat <- counts_mat[, cell_ids, drop = FALSE]
logcounts_mat <- logcounts_mat[, cell_ids, drop = FALSE]

sce_lineage <- SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(
    counts = counts_mat,
    logcounts = logcounts_mat
  ),
  colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(
    clustering = as.character(fine_labels),
    cluster_name = as.character(fine_labels),
    row.names = cell_ids
  ),
  reducedDims = S4Vectors::SimpleList(
    PCA = full_pca,
    PCA_1_5 = full_pca[, 1:5, drop = FALSE]
  )
)

if ("umap3d" %in% names(seu_orig@reductions)) {
  SingleCellExperiment::reducedDim(sce_lineage, "UMAP3D") <-
    SeuratObject::Embeddings(seu_orig, "umap3d")[cell_ids, 1:3, drop = FALSE]
}

set.seed(12345)
sce_lineage <- slingshot::slingshot(
  sce_lineage,
  clusterLabels = "cluster_name",
  reducedDim = "PCA_1_5",
  start.clus = "GBC",
  end.clus = c("HBC", "Sus", "MV")
)

lineage_summary <- lineage_table(sce_lineage)
lineage_summary
```

## Use an existing in-memory SCE

This section summarizes an existing `sce_lineage` object.

```{r existing-sce}
# Inspect fitted lineages and pseudotime ranges before plotting or saving them.
cell_ids <- colnames(sce_lineage)
fine_labels <- as.character(
  SummarizedExperiment::colData(sce_lineage)$cluster_name
)
lineage_summary <- lineage_table(sce_lineage)
pseudotime <- as.data.frame(slingshot::slingPseudotime(sce_lineage))
curve_weights <- as.data.frame(slingshot::slingCurveWeights(sce_lineage))
```

## Save the Slingshot object

tradeSeq consumes the fitted SCE's pseudotime and curve-weight matrices. The
The fitted SCE contains the pseudotime and curve-weight matrices used by tradeSeq.

```{r save-results, cache=FALSE}
# Save the Slingshot object for downstream plotting when output writing is enabled.
if (isTRUE(params$save_outputs)) {
  saveRDS(sce_lineage, file.path(results_objects_dir, "slingshot_output.rds"))
}


pseudotime <- as.data.frame(slingshot::slingPseudotime(sce_lineage))
curve_weights <- as.data.frame(slingshot::slingCurveWeights(sce_lineage))

```

## Project the exact saved rotated 3D view

These three files preserve the coordinates, camera rotation, and embedded
Slingshot curves used for the rotated supplement figure. Keeping them fixed
prevents a new UMAP or a different camera state from changing the figure.

```{r rotated-view}
# Load the saved 3D view used for the trajectory figure.
sce_lineage <- lineage_clean
cell_ids <- colnames(lineage_clean)

coordinates_path <- file.path(
  projection_dir,
  "04_slingshot_rgl_coordinates.rds"
)
view_state_path <- file.path(
  projection_dir,
  "04_slingshot_rgl_view_state.rds"
)
curves_path <- file.path(
  projection_dir,
  "04_slingshot_umap_curves_pcs1_to5_april13.rds"
)

projection_files <- c(
  coordinates_path,
  view_state_path,
  curves_path
)

if (!all(file.exists(projection_files))) {
  stop(
    "Missing projection file: ",
    paste(projection_files[!file.exists(projection_files)], collapse = "; ")
  )
}

rgl_coordinates <- readRDS(coordinates_path)
saved_view <- readRDS(view_state_path)
saved_curve_ordering <- readRDS(curves_path)

if (is.null(rownames(rgl_coordinates))) {
  stop("The saved 3D coordinates have no cell names.")
}

missing_cells <- setdiff(
  cell_ids,
  rownames(rgl_coordinates)
)

if (length(missing_cells) > 0) {
  stop(
    "lineage_clean does not contain the same cells as the saved 3D coordinates. ",
    "Missing coordinate rows: ",
    length(missing_cells)
  )
}

rgl_coordinates <- rgl_coordinates[
  cell_ids,
  1:3,
  drop = FALSE
]
rgl::open3d(useNULL = TRUE)
rgl::plot3d(
  rgl_coordinates[, 1], rgl_coordinates[, 2], rgl_coordinates[, 3],
  type = "n", axes = FALSE, box = FALSE,
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = ""
)
rgl::par3d(
  userMatrix = saved_view$userMatrix,
  zoom = saved_view$zoom,
  FOV = saved_view$FOV,
  scale = saved_view$scale
)

projected_cells <- project_rgl_view(rgl_coordinates)

celltype_palette <- c(
  "mOSN 3" = "#EF7677",
  "mOSN 2" = "#E94849",
  "mOSN 1" = "#E41A1C",
  "iOSN 3" = "#87B2D4",
  "iOSN 2" = "#5F98C6",
  "iOSN 1" = "#377EB8",
  "late INP" = "#94CF92",
  "early INP" = "#4DAF4A",
  "GBC" = "#C195C8",
  "Sus" = "#FFFF85",
  "HBC" = "#CA9A7E",
  "MV" = "#FFB266"
)
unmapped_cell_types <- setdiff(unique(fine_labels), names(celltype_palette))
if (length(unmapped_cell_types) > 0) {
  celltype_palette <- c(
    celltype_palette,
    stats::setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(unmapped_cell_types)), unmapped_cell_types)
  )
}

cell_plot_data <- data.frame(
  Dim_1 = projected_cells$Dim_1,
  Dim_2 = projected_cells$Dim_2,
  Cell_Type = factor(fine_labels, levels = names(celltype_palette)),
  row.names = cell_ids
)

saved_curves <- slingshot::slingCurves(saved_curve_ordering)
new_lineage_endpoints <- lineage_summary$endpoint
if (length(saved_curves) != length(new_lineage_endpoints)) {
  warning(
    "The saved 3D curve count (", length(saved_curves),
    ") differs from the newly fitted Slingshot lineage count (",
    length(new_lineage_endpoints), "). Using saved curve numbering."
  )
}

curve_plot_data <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_along(saved_curves), function(index) {
    curve <- saved_curves[[index]]
    curve_xyz <- curve$s[curve$ord, 1:3, drop = FALSE]
    curve_xy <- project_rgl_view(curve_xyz)
    endpoint <- if (index <= length(new_lineage_endpoints)) {
      new_lineage_endpoints[[index]]
    } else {
      paste0("Lineage_", index)
    }
    data.frame(
      Dim_1 = curve_xy$Dim_1,
      Dim_2 = curve_xy$Dim_2,
      Lineage = endpoint,
      Point_Order = seq_len(nrow(curve_xy)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

lineage_levels <- unique(curve_plot_data$Lineage)
curve_plot_data$Lineage <- factor(curve_plot_data$Lineage, levels = lineage_levels)
neuronal_endpoints <- lineage_levels[grepl("^mOSN", lineage_levels)]
lineage_palette <- c(
  stats::setNames(rep("#642C9B", length(neuronal_endpoints)), neuronal_endpoints),
  "Sus" = "#278ABD",
  "HBC" = "#11A189",
  "MV" = "#DA6004"
)
unmapped_lineages <- setdiff(lineage_levels, names(lineage_palette))
if (length(unmapped_lineages) > 0) {
  lineage_palette <- c(
    lineage_palette,
    stats::setNames(scales::hue_pal(l = 45)(length(unmapped_lineages)), unmapped_lineages)
  )
}
rgl::close3d()
```

## Rotated Slingshot figure

```{r rotated-slingshot-plot}
# Project the fitted 3D curves and assemble the published rotated Slingshot plot.
rotated_slingshot_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = cell_plot_data,
    aes(x = Dim_1, y = Dim_2, color = Cell_Type),
    size = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = celltype_palette,
    name = "Cell Type:",
    drop = FALSE,
    guide = guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  geom_path(
    data = curve_plot_data,
    aes(x = Dim_1, y = Dim_2, group = Lineage, color = Lineage),
    linewidth = 1.05,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = lineage_palette,
    name = "Lineage:",
    drop = FALSE,
    guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "left",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.38, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.5)))

plot_base <- file.path(plot_dir, "trajec_umap_flat_rotated_pc1to5")
rotated_slingshot_plot
```
